records.subject: module.factQueryRuntime
records.sourceText:
// Canonical fact-query semantic witness. The executable module is an interpreter
// boundary; query, projection, history, polarity and serialization semantics are
// authored here so the runtime does not become an opaque second specification.

("module.factQueryRuntime", "isa", "AlgebraModule")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "sourceDomain", "FactSourcesFactPatternsQueryOptionsAndSerializationRequests")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "targetDomain", "FactViewsBindingsProjectionsBuffersAndSerializedFacts")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "forwardMap", "factQueryRuntime.operation")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "reverseMapOrAbsence", "EveryQueryAndSerializationReceiptRetainsSourceModePatternSelectionAndExplicitEmptyResult")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "preservedInformation", "FactIdentityPolarityHistoryBindingsSelectionOrderProjectionAndSerializationFormat")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "lostInformation", "UnselectedBindingsOriginalSourceContainerIdentityAndUnrequestedHostIterationControlFlow")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "identity", "SourceThenModeThenPatternThenBindingThenProjectionThenSerialization")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "partiality", "UnsupportedPatternsAndSourceShapesRefuse;EmptySourceIsExplicitEmptyFactSpace")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "failure", "VisibleTypedPatternSourceOrSerializationRefusalWithoutImplicitMutation")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "authorityEffect", "QueryProjectionAndSerializationArePure;FactBufferMutationIsExplicitCallerOwnedState")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "stateOwner", "InjectedFactSourceOrCallerOwnedFactBuffer")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "evidence", "ExactSourceModePatternsBindingsProjectionAndSerializedDigest")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "falsifier", "HiddenSourceCoercionImplicitPlannerPolarityCollapseOrUnreportedSerializationLoss")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "default", "NoImplicitSourceContainerQueryStrategyOrderingSelectionOrMutation")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "lifecycle", "NormalizeSourceSelectHistoryOrActiveCandidatesMatchJoinOrderProjectSerializeAndRecover")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "symmetryBreak", "FactPolarityHistoryAndOptionalBindingsRemainDistinctUntilExplicitQuerySemanticsCollapseThem")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "semanticOwner", "repository.sourceryPlatform")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "targetOwner", "repository.sourceryPlatform")
("module.factQueryRuntime", "interpreterComponent", "sdk/runtime/fact-query.mjs")

("factQueryRuntime.operation", "isa", "FactQueryRuntimeOperation")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "sourceNormalization")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "activeCandidateSelection")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "historyCandidateSelection")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "patternJoin")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "optionalPatternBinding")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "declaredOrdering")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "declaredSelectionProjection")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "factProjection")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "textSerialization")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "binarySerialization")
("factQueryRuntime.operation", "operation", "mutableFactAppendAndReplace")

("factQueryRuntime.strategy.active", "isa", "DeclaredFactQueryStrategy")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.active", "mode", "active")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.active", "polarityRule", "latestFactPerTripleExcludesIsNot")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.history", "isa", "DeclaredFactQueryStrategy")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.history", "mode", "history")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.history", "polarityRule", "preservesWitnessEntriesAndPolarity")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.join", "isa", "DeclaredFactQueryStrategy")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.join", "strategy", "orderedPatternJoinWithExplicitOptionalBindings")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.join", "anchorRequirement", "callerSuppliedPatterns")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.join", "hiddenPlanner", "forbidden")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.order", "isa", "DeclaredFactQueryStrategy")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.order", "strategy", "callerSuppliedFieldAndDirection")
("factQueryRuntime.strategy.order", "hiddenPlanner", "forbidden")
